# BuildMeLeads

> BuildMeLeads is an open-source, self-hostable B2B lead generation and cold outreach platform built with Node.js, Python FastAPI, SQLite, and Groq LLMs.

## Core Capabilities
- Google Maps Lead Scraping: Native integration with containerized gosom scraper.
- Google Business Profile (GBP) Audit: Automated detection of weak profiles (missing websites, unverified listings, low reviews, poor ratings).
- Contact Enrichment: Fast HTTP and Playwright scraping for business emails, phone numbers (E.164), and social links.
- AI Outreach Personalization: Groq LLM-driven generation of high-converting, 1-to-1 cold emails referencing specific business gaps.
- Safe Sending Engine: Recipient local timezone restriction (M-F 9am-5pm), randomized jitter (15-45m), automatic bounce circuit breakers, and suppression handling.
- Multi-Provider Dispatch: Gmail OAuth 2.0 (encrypted tokens) and SendGrid API.

## Architecture
- Dashboard: Node.js / Express (Port 3000)
- Engine: Python FastAPI (Port 8000)
- Scraper: Docker gosom / Google Maps (Port 8080)
- Storage: SQLite multi-tenant with Argon2id authentication
